title: 4th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/4/1/2026).
First reading of the Bill to amend the Maldives Land Act (Law No. 1/2002), submitted by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
First reading of the Bill to amend the Land Transport Act (Law No. 5/2009), submitted by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim.

First reading of a resolution submitted by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim, to gauge the view of members on actions the government is taking contrary to the Constitution, relevant laws and the 2026 state budget passed by the Majlis.
Preliminary debate on the Bill to amend the Employment Act (Law No. 2/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Madaveli MP Mohamed Shameez.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the National Service Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by South Kulhudhuffushi MP Faruhath Mohamed.
Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on the President's nominee for membership of the Elections Commission, under Article 4(b) of the Elections Commission Act (Law No. 8/2008).

Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's request for the Majlis's consent for the Maldives to join the Labour Centre of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation and to sign and ratify its statute.

Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's submission for appointing non-resident ambassadors of the Maldives to the Republic of Cuba, the Federative Republic of Brazil and the United Mexican States.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to introduce two opposition bills and a resolution, begin debate on the government Employment Act amendment, continue the National Service Bill, and take up reports on an Elections Commission nominee, the OIC Labour Centre and three ambassadors.
